# load Packages
```{r}
#| message: false 
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

# Import FBI Data 
```{r}
#| message: false 
fbi_t1 <- read_excel(here::here("data/Table_1_2025.xlsx"))

fbi_t2 <- read_excel(here::here("data/Table_11_2025.xlsx"))
```

# Import SFPD Data 
```{r}
#| message: false 
sfpd <- read_csv(here::here("data/SFPD.csv"))
```


# Glimpse Data 

```{r}
glimpse(fbi_t1)

glimpse(fbi_t2)

glimpse(sfpd)
```
